DILG Republic of the Philippines DEPARTMENT OF THE INTERIOR AND LOCAL GOVERNMENT DILG-NAPOLCOM Center, EDSA corner Quezon Avenue, West Triangle, Quezon City http: //www.dilg.com.ph DILG OPINION No. 98 s. 2022 September 19, 2022 HON. CESYL L. BALAHAY Vice-Mayor Alicia, Bohol Dear Vice-Mayor Balahay: This has reference to your various communications requesting for guidance and assistance relative to the political situation in Alicia, Bohol. Based on the documents forwarded to the Central Office, the following are the antecedent facts: Mr. Marnilou Ayuban won as Mayor Of Alicia, Bohol during the May 2022 National and Local Elections and was duly proclaimed on Mayo IC), 2022 by the local COMELEC. She took his ceremonial Oath of Office on June 8, 2022; Mr. Victoriano C. Torres Ill is a mayoral candidate garnering the second highest votes. He was the only opponent of Mr. Marnilou Ayuban; On May 17, 2022, Mr. Torres III filed a Petition for Quo Warranto against Ms. Ayuban before RTC, 7th Judicial Region, Branch 51, Carmen, Bohol on the ground that Mr. Ayuban committed material misrepresentation when he stated in Item 11 of her COC that he is eligible to run for public office and in Item 22 when he stated under oath that he was not found guilty by final and executory judgment for an offense which carries with it the accessory penalty of perpetual disqualification to hold public office. On June 30, 2022, Mayor Ayuban, issued Executive Order (EO) No. I series of 2022 creating the Office of the Municipal Administrator and appointing Ms. Junavie L. Piquero as temporary Municipal Administrator; On the same date, Ms. Piquero was designated by Mayor Ayuban as the Officer-in-Charge, On July 14, 2022, as Vice-Mayor, you wrote to DILG Region VII requesting clarification on his status as Acting Mayor considering that the decision of RTC, 7th Judicial Region, Branch 51, Carmen, Bohol finding Mayor Marnilou Ayuban et.al. guilty beyond reasonable doubt for violation of Section 3 (c) of the Anti-Graft and Corrupt Practices Act has become final and executory. Matino, Mahusay at Maasahan" Trunkline No.: 8876-34-54

o o The decision of the RTC was affirmed by the Court of Appeals Cebu City (Special 20th Division) in its Decision dated March 12, 2019. The CA affirmed the conviction of the accused-appellants with modifications as to its penalty wherein they are adjudged to suffer the penalty of imprisonment for an indeterminate period of six (6) years and one (1) month as minimum to ten (IO) years and six (6) months as maximum with perpetual disqualification from public office; The Motion for Reconsideration was denied by the CA. Likewise, the Petition for Review on Certiorari filed before the Supreme Court was denied, On October 14, 2020, the decision of the Supreme Court has become final and executory. Per report from DILG R7, Mayor Ayuban is nowhere to be found due to the standing warrant of arrest issued against her; On July 18, 2022 without knowing of the R TC's decision on the Petition for Quo.Warranto, DILG Region VII issued its legal opinion addressed to VM Balahay citing Section 44 of the Local Government Code that there is a permanent vacancy in the Office of the Mayor of Alicia, Bohol since Mr. Ayuban is guilty of a crime that carries the accessory penalty of perpetual disqualification from Office and that Mr. Balahay shall sit as the Mayor of Alicia; On July 26, 2022, you requested DILG R7 to issue a directive that he can now assume as Mayor of Alicia; On July 27, 2022, this Level received a communication from Atty. Prosencio D. Jaso, Counsel of Mr. Victoriano C. Torress Ill, requesting to install his client as Mayor of Alicia and remove the Administrator appointed by Mayor Ayuban; On August 4, 2022, Dir. Jerome G. Gonzales, Provincial Director of DILG Bohol, issued a certification that per their records you are the incumbent Mayor of Alicia having assumed office by succession on August 3, 2022; On August 8, 2022, Mayor Ayuban wrote to PD Gonzales stating that: The certification dated August 4, 2022 issued by PD Gonzales certifying that VM Balahay is the incumbent Mayor by succession has no basis in fact and in law; o He was deprived of due process since the letter dated July 18, 2022 signed by RD Leocadio T. Trovela and the certification issued by PD Gonzales were not properly furnished to his office; There is no vacancy since he is performing his functions as Municipal Mayor; Page 2 of 4

Reliance on the printed copy of the email of VM Balahay and the irresponsible issuance of the certification by PD Gonzales; and o He ordered PD Gonzales to revoke the certification saying that PD Gonzales overstepped his power and caused great confusion and chaos to the town. In your letter to this Office requesting for guidance, you already addressed yourself as Mayor of Alicia, Bohol having assumed office on August 3, 2022; On August 23, 2022, this Office received a letter from Mayor Ayuban requesting that the guidance issued by DILG Region VII recognizing VM Balahay as Mayor be reversed based on the following: o On August 16, 2022, thru counsel, he filed a Notice of Appeal to the decision of RTC Branch 51 in the Quo Warranto petition; o He alleged that the Motion for Execution Pending Appeal file by Mr. Torres in relation to the RTC Branch 51 Decision on the Quo Warranto case was prohibited pursuant to Rule 14, Section II of A.M. No. IO-4- I-SC; On March 30, 2022, he filed a Second Motion for Reconsideration O before the Supreme Court in relation to the criminal case C.A.-G.R. CEB CR No. 02940 which adjudged him to suffer the penalty of imprisonment for an indeterminate period of six (6) years and one (1) month as minimum to ten (IO) years and six (6) months as maximum with perpetual disqualification from public office; The warrant of arrest issued by RTC Branch 51 against him was assailed before the Court of Appeals Cebu City via Certiorari under Rule 65 on June 28, 2022 At this juncture, please be informed that the communication of RD Trovela dated July 18, 2022 declaring the existence of a permanent vacancy in the Office of the Mayor was issued without knowing of the R TC's decision on the Petition for Quo Warranto. The aforesaid guidance rendered by DILG Region VII has become moot and inapplicable in light of the subsequent events that took place. Nevertheless, considering that the Commission on Elections (COMELEC) has jurisdiction over issues and cases arising from the national and local elections, this Department will defer to their wisdom to settle the issue on who is the rightful Mayor of Alicia, Bohol. Likewise, this Level is requesting the Commission's guidance relative to the ruling of RTC Branch 51. Pending guidance from the COMELEC and the final disposition of the Petition for Quo Warranto, this Department is constrained to declare a temporary vacancy in the Office of the Mayor to prevent hiatus and paralysis in the government operations. Page 3 of 4

Section 46 of the Local Government Code of 1991 provides for the procedure in filling in the temporary vacancy in the office of the Local Chief Executive, to wit: SECTION 46. Temporary Vacancy in the Office of the Local Chief Executive. — (a) When the governor, city or municipal mayor, or punong barangay is temporarily incapacitated to perform his duties for physical or legal reasons such as, but not limited to, leave of absence, travel abroad, and suspension from office, the vice-governor. city or municipal vice-mayor. or the highest rankinq sanqquniang barangay member shall automatically exercise the powers and perform the duties and functions of the local chief executive concerned, except the power to appoint, suspend, or dismiss employees which can only be exercised if the period of temporary incapacity exceeds thirty (30) working days. Hence, as the duly elected Vice-Mayor, you shall sit as Acting Mayor by virtue of automatic succession. Meanwhile, the highest Sangguniang Bayan Member, Marciano S. Ayuban, Jr., pursuant to Administrative Order No. 151 per designation by the Secretary of DILG, shall sit as Acting Vice-Mayor. The foregoing is being rendered without prejudice to any contrary opinion of competent authorities and the courts. We hope to have addressed your concern accordingly. Thank you. Very truly yours, BY AUTHORITY OF THE SECRETARY: Undersecr ry for Local Government OUSLG/MLl/LLLS-LRALLD/clp/OD copy furnished: DIRECTOR LEOCADIO T.
